conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I don't think this degree is right for me.
sentences.displayHtml: I don't think this degree is right for me.

sentences.text: I'm scared to tell my parents.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm scared to tell my parents.

conversation.japanese: この学部、自分には合ってないと思う。親に言うのが怖いんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I know full well how hard you've been trying.
sentences.displayHtml: I know full well how hard you've been trying.

conversation.japanese: ずっと頑張ってるのはよくわかってるよ。本当は何をしたい？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Maybe I'm thinking out loud, but I'd like to study design instead.
sentences.displayHtml: Maybe I'm thinking out loud, but I'd like to study design instead.

conversation.japanese: まだ考えながら話してるんだけど、代わりにデザインを学びたい。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: You don't have to decide everything tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: You don't have to decide everything tonight.

conversation.japanese: 調べてみる価値はありそうだね。今夜、全部決めなくていいよ。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Could you help me work out how to explain it?
sentences.displayHtml: Could you help me work out how to explain it?

sentences.text: I don't want to sound ungrateful.
sentences.displayHtml: I don't want to sound ungrateful.

conversation.japanese: どう説明するか一緒に考えてくれる？ 感謝してないみたいには聞こえたくなくて。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Let's start with why it matters to you and make a plan.
sentences.displayHtml: Let's start with why it matters to you and make a plan.

conversation.japanese: もちろん。なぜ大事なのかから整理して、計画を立てよう。

lyricConnections.explanationJa: know full well は、十分にわかっていると強調する表現。
